Trajectory‑Specific Associations in Recurrent PSUD Care (Table 3-like)

Private exploratory companion to Table 3 in the SISTRAT 2022 recurrent-care cohort (27,445 patients, 67,957 episodes). Reproduces all 15 adjusted GEE estimates of the association between polysubstance use disorder (PSUD) at admission and treatment non-completion, then re-estimates them within 12 feasible strata defined by index setting (GP/WO x basic ambulatory, intensive ambulatory, residential) and the first-to-second treatment intensity change (higher, same, lower), fixed per patient. Reports patient-cluster robust risk ratios under the corrected five-setting IIW, unweighted estimates, and IIW recalculated within the 15 joint strata), a readmissions-only companion excluding index episodes, trajectory coverage and persistence after the first readmission, and Cochran’s Q heterogeneity tests. Estimates are descriptive trajectory-specific associations; conditioning on the first-readmission setting does not identify an effect of changing intensity. Corrected five-setting weights are shared with postrev23 and the concurrent-setting sensitivity notebook; manuscript source is not modified.

Exploratory Table 3 by index setting and first-readmission intensity

This private exploration estimates the adjusted association of PSUD at admission with treatment non-completion using the established covariates and modified-Poisson GEE specification. It compares corrected five-setting lag0 and lag1 IIW with unweighted models, then separately re-estimates IIW within the joint transition strata. All-episode and readmissions-only analyses are retained.

The second setting is the first readmission. Each patient’s first-to-second intensity category is fixed across the trajectory. The nominal grid has 15 rows and 12 observed strata; the other three are structurally impossible. Same intensity includes between-programme moves at the same modality.

Corrected weights are shared with prop_grantt_25_postrev23.ipynb and matched by unique episode key. The analysis verifies the corrected Table 3 anchors, unchanged unweighted estimates and unchanged transition counts before interpretation. It exports patient-robust intervals, sample support, comparisons, diagnostics and exploratory Cochran Q statistics. No effect of changing treatment intensity is identified by conditioning on these observed trajectories.

  check("Fifteen rows, three structural zeros, twelve supported strata", nrow(cohort) == 15L &&

  # Reduce only constant or aliased terms, exactly as in the existing Table 3 refit.
  # Never drop PSUD, impute covariates, recode the endpoint, or change the corrected five-setting IIWs.
  full_formula <- stats::reformulate(base_terms, response = "tr_noncompletion")
  reduce_formula <- function(mf) {
    x <- stats::model.matrix(full_formula, mf)
    assign_vec <- attr(x, "assign")
    constant <- vapply(as.data.frame(x), function(v) length(unique(v)) == 1L, logical(1))
    constant[colnames(x) == "(Intercept)"] <- FALSE
    constant_names <- colnames(x)[constant]
    x <- x[, !constant, drop = FALSE]
    assign_vec <- assign_vec[!constant]
    qr_x <- base::qr(x)
    keep_cols <- qr_x$pivot[seq_len(qr_x$rank)]
    kept_terms <- unique(attr(stats::terms(full_formula), "term.labels")[assign_vec[keep_cols]])
    kept_terms <- kept_terms[!is.na(kept_terms)]
    if (!"polysubstance_strict" %in% kept_terms) stop("PSUD is not estimable in this stratum.")
    ff <- stats::reformulate(kept_terms, response = "tr_noncompletion")
    xx <- stats::model.matrix(ff, mf)
    stopifnot(base::qr(xx)$rank == ncol(xx))
    list(formula = ff, dropped = paste(setdiff(base_terms, kept_terms), collapse = "; "),
      constants = paste(constant_names, collapse = "; "), n_coef = ncol(xx))
  }
  diagnostics <- list()
  raw_support <- list()
  fit_one <- function(df, domain, family_label, origin, direction, weight) {
    result <- data.frame(domain = domain, stratification = family_label, origin = origin,
      direction = direction, weight = weight, n_rows = nrow(df), n_patients = dplyr::n_distinct(df$id),
      log_RR = NA_real_, robust_se = NA_real_, RR = NA_real_, conf_low = NA_real_, conf_high = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_, status = if (nrow(df) == 0L) "Structural zero" else "Pending")
    if (!nrow(df)) return(result)
    warning_text <- character()
    fit_result <- tryCatch(withCallingHandlers({
      mf <- stats::model.frame(full_formula, data = df, na.action = stats::na.fail)
      if (length(unique(mf$polysubstance_strict)) < 2L || length(unique(mf$tr_noncompletion)) < 2L) stop("No exposure/outcome variation.")
      spec <- reduce_formula(mf)
      w <- if (weight == "unweighted") rep(1, nrow(df)) else df[[weight]]
      ids <- df$id
      stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(rle(ids)$values), all(is.finite(w) & w > 0))
      ff <- spec$formula
      environment(ff) <- environment()
      fit <- geepack::geeglm(formula = ff, id = ids, data = mf, weights = w,
        family = stats::poisson(link = "log"), corstr = "independence", scale.fix = TRUE,
        na.action = stats::na.fail, std.err = "san.se")
      b <- stats::coef(fit)
      v <- fit$geese$vbeta
      j <- match("polysubstance_strict", names(b))
      if (fit$geese$error != 0L || !all(is.finite(b)) || !all(is.finite(v)) || v[j, j] <= 0) stop("Non-converged fit or invalid robust variance.")
      beta <- unname(b[j])
      se <- sqrt(v[j, j])
      z <- stats::qnorm(0.975)
      cluster_weights <- as.numeric(rowsum(w, ids, reorder = FALSE))
      cross <- table(factor(df$polysubstance_strict, levels = 0:1), factor(df$tr_noncompletion, levels = 0:1))
      diagnostic <- data.frame(domain = domain, stratification = family_label, origin = origin,
        direction = direction, weight = weight, geese_error = fit$geese$error,
        n_coefficients = spec$n_coef, dropped_terms = spec$dropped, constant_columns = spec$constants,
        smallest_psud_outcome_cell = min(cross), min_weight = min(w), max_weight = max(w),
        weight_ess_episodes = sum(w)^2 / sum(w^2), weight_ess_cluster_totals = sum(cluster_weights)^2 / sum(cluster_weights^2),
        fitted_above_one = sum(stats::fitted(fit) > 1), max_fitted = max(stats::fitted(fit)),
        warnings = "")
      list(beta = beta, se = se, rr = exp(beta), lo = exp(beta - z * se), hi = exp(beta + z * se),
        p = 2 * stats::pnorm(abs(beta / se), lower.tail = FALSE), diagnostic = diagnostic)
    }, warning = function(w) { warning_text <<- c(warning_text, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning") }),
      error = function(e) list(error = conditionMessage(e)))
    if (!is.null(fit_result$error)) {
      result$status <- paste("Not estimable:", fit_result$error)
      cat("MODEL ISSUE:", domain, family_label, origin, direction, weight, result$status, "\n")
    } else {
      result[c("log_RR", "robust_se", "RR", "conf_low", "conf_high", "p_value")] <-
        list(fit_result$beta, fit_result$se, fit_result$rr, fit_result$lo, fit_result$hi, fit_result$p)
      result$status <- if (length(warning_text)) "Estimated with warning" else "Estimated"
      fit_result$diagnostic$warnings <- paste(unique(warning_text), collapse = "; ")
      diagnostics[[length(diagnostics) + 1L]] <<- fit_result$diagnostic
    }
    result
  }
  domains <- c("All episodes", "Readmissions only")
  results_list <- list()
  for (domain in domains) {
    dd <- if (domain == "All episodes") dat else dplyr::filter(dat, episode_rank >= 2L)

    }
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid))) {

      for (weight in names(weight_labels)) results_list[[length(results_list) + 1L]] <-

    }
    raw_support[[length(raw_support) + 1L]] <- dd |>
      dplyr::group_by(origin, direction, polysubstance_strict) |>
      dplyr::summarise(episodes = dplyr::n(), patients = dplyr::n_distinct(id),
        noncompletion = sum(tr_noncompletion), completion = sum(tr_noncompletion == 0L),
        noncompletion_pct = 100 * mean(tr_noncompletion), .groups = "drop") |>
      dplyr::mutate(domain = domain)
    cat("Completed", domain, "models.\n")
  }
  results <- dplyr::bind_rows(results_list)
  diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(diagnostics)
  write_csv(results, "estimates_long.csv")
  write_csv(diagnostics, "model_diagnostics.csv")
  write_csv(dplyr::bind_rows(raw_support), "psud_noncompletion_support.csv")
  check("All 102 supported models estimated", nrow(results) == 120L && sum(results$status == "Structural zero") == 18L &&
    sum(results$status %in% c("Estimated", "Estimated with warning")) == 102L && nrow(diagnostics) == 102L)

  reference <- utils::read.csv(reference_models)
  reference <- reference[reference$stratifier == "index (primary)", , drop = FALSE]
  reference$origin <- unname(map[reference$stratum])
  baseline <- dplyr::filter(results, domain == "All episodes", stratification == "Index setting")
  validated <- dplyr::full_join(baseline, reference[c("origin", "weight", "n_rows", "n_patients", "RR", "conf_low", "conf_high")],
    by = c("origin", "weight"), suffix = c("_new", "_reference"))
  validated$max_abs_difference <- pmax(abs(validated$RR_new - validated$RR_reference),
    abs(validated$conf_low_new - validated$conf_low_reference), abs(validated$conf_high_new - validated$conf_high_reference))
  check("Five unweighted Table 3 anchors remain unchanged", nrow(validated) == 15L &&
    all(validated$max_abs_difference[validated$weight == "unweighted"] < 1e-7) &&
    all(validated$n_rows_new == validated$n_rows_reference) && all(validated$n_patients_new == validated$n_patients_reference))
  prior <- utils::read.csv("output/exploratory_table3_first_readmission_20260911_125809/estimates_long.csv")
  unweighted_validation <- dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::filter(results, weight == "unweighted", status != "Structural zero"),
    dplyr::filter(prior, weight == "unweighted", status != "Structural zero"),
    by = c("domain", "stratification", "origin", "direction", "weight"), suffix = c("", "_historical"))
  check("All 34 unweighted estimates and intervals remain unchanged", nrow(unweighted_validation) == 34L &&
    max(abs(unweighted_validation$RR - unweighted_validation$RR_historical)) < 1e-7 &&
    max(abs(unweighted_validation$conf_low - unweighted_validation$conf_low_historical)) < 1e-7 &&
    max(abs(unweighted_validation$conf_high - unweighted_validation$conf_high_historical)) < 1e-7)
  write_csv(unweighted_validation, "unweighted_preservation_validation.csv")
  write_csv(baseline, "corrected_table3_anchors.csv")
  corrected_reference$origin <- unname(map[corrected_reference$setting])
  shared_validation <- dplyr::inner_join(baseline, corrected_reference,
    by = c("origin", "weight"), suffix = c("", "_shared"))
  check("All 15 Table 3 estimates reproduce the shared corrected postrev23 reference", nrow(shared_validation) == 15L &&
    max(abs(shared_validation$RR - shared_validation$RR_shared)) < 1e-7 &&
    max(abs(shared_validation$conf_low - shared_validation$conf_low_shared)) < 1e-7 &&
    max(abs(shared_validation$conf_high - shared_validation$conf_high_shared)) < 1e-7)
  write_csv(shared_validation, "shared_corrected_table3_validation.csv")
  write_csv(validated, "table3_reference_validation.csv")
  ref_re <- utils::read.csv(reference_readmissions)
  ref_re$origin <- unname(map[ref_re$stratum])
  val_re <- dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::filter(results, domain == "Readmissions only", stratification == "Index setting", weight == "w1_tr"),
    ref_re[c("origin", "RR", "conf_low", "conf_high", "n_rows", "n_patients")], by = "origin", suffix = c("_new", "_reference"))
  check("Readmission-only comparison preserves every episode and patient", nrow(val_re) == 5L &&
    all(val_re$n_rows_new == val_re$n_rows_reference) && all(val_re$n_patients_new == val_re$n_patients_reference))
  write_csv(val_re, "readmissions_reference_validation.csv")

  # Q uses unrounded coefficients and robust variances, conditional on corrected IIW.
  # No patient appears in two joint strata; no parent-vs-subgroup independence test is made.
  q_checks <- numeric()
  cochran_q <- function(x, scope, domain, weight) {
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(x$log_RR)), all(is.finite(x$robust_se) & x$robust_se > 0), nrow(x) >= 2L)
    b <- x$log_RR
    variance <- x$robust_se^2
    inv <- 1 / variance
    pooled <- sum(inv * b) / sum(inv)
    q <- sum(inv * (b - pooled)^2)
    k <- length(b)
    contrast <- cbind(-1, diag(k - 1L))
    delta <- as.numeric(contrast %*% b)
    vv <- contrast %*% diag(variance) %*% t(contrast)
    q_wald <- as.numeric(crossprod(delta, solve(vv, delta)))
    q_checks <<- c(q_checks, abs(q - q_wald))
    data.frame(domain = domain, weight = weight, scope = scope, k = k, Q = q, df = k - 1L,
      p_value = stats::pchisq(q, k - 1L, lower.tail = FALSE),
      strata = paste(paste(x$origin, x$direction, sep = ": "), collapse = "; "))
  }
  q_list <- list()
  for (domain in domains) for (weight in names(weight_labels)) {
    b <- dplyr::filter(results, .data$domain == .env$domain, .data$weight == .env$weight, stratification == "Index setting")
    j <- dplyr::filter(results, .data$domain == .env$domain, .data$weight == .env$weight,
      stratification == "Index x first-readmission intensity", status != "Structural zero")
    q_list[[length(q_list) + 1L]] <- cochran_q(b, "Across 5 index settings (reference)", domain, weight)
    total_q <- cochran_q(j, "Across 12 joint strata", domain, weight)
    q_list[[length(q_list) + 1L]] <- total_q
    within_rows <- list()
    for (origin_value in settings) {
      qq <- cochran_q(j[j$origin == origin_value, ], paste("Across intensity groups within", origin_value), domain, weight)
      within_rows[[length(within_rows) + 1L]] <- qq
      q_list[[length(q_list) + 1L]] <- qq
    }
    within <- dplyr::bind_rows(within_rows)
    q_within <- sum(within$Q)
    df_within <- sum(within$df)
    q_list[[length(q_list) + 1L]] <- data.frame(domain = domain, weight = weight,
      scope = "Combined intensity heterogeneity within index settings", k = 12L,
      Q = q_within, df = df_within, p_value = stats::pchisq(q_within, df_within, lower.tail = FALSE),
      strata = "Sum of five disjoint within-index-setting Q statistics; 7 degrees of freedom")
    stopifnot(df_within == 7L, q_within <= total_q$Q + 1e-8)
    for (direction_value in directions) q_list[[length(q_list) + 1L]] <-
      cochran_q(j[j$direction == direction_value, ], paste("Across index settings within", tolower(direction_value)), domain, weight)
  }
  q_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(q_list)
  check("Q equals independent contrast-Wald calculation", length(q_checks) == 60L && max(q_checks) < 1e-8,
    sprintf("maximum absolute difference %.3g", max(q_checks)))
  write_csv(q_results, "cochran_q_heterogeneity.csv")
  index_same_domain <- dplyr::filter(results, stratification == "Index setting") |>
    dplyr::select(domain, origin, weight, parent_RR = RR, parent_se = robust_se, parent_low = conf_low, parent_high = conf_high)
  original <- baseline |> dplyr::select(origin, weight, original_RR = RR, original_se = robust_se,
    original_low = conf_low, original_high = conf_high)
  comparisons <- dplyr::filter(results, stratification != "Index setting") |>
    dplyr::left_join(index_same_domain, by = c("domain", "origin", "weight")) |>
    dplyr::left_join(original, by = c("origin", "weight")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RR_ratio_vs_original_table3 = RR / original_RR,
      robust_se_ratio_vs_original = robust_se / original_se,
      CI_width_ratio_vs_original = (conf_high - conf_low) / (original_high - original_low),
      RR_ratio_vs_same_domain_parent = RR / parent_RR,
      point_direction_vs_null = dplyr::case_when(is.na(RR) ~ "Not estimable", RR > 1 ~ "Above 1", RR < 1 ~ "Below 1", TRUE ~ "Exactly 1"),
      CI_relation_to_null = dplyr::case_when(is.na(RR) ~ "Not estimable", conf_low > 1 ~ "Entirely above 1",
        conf_high < 1 ~ "Entirely below 1", TRUE ~ "Includes 1"))
  write_csv(comparisons, "comparison_with_original_table3.csv")
  format_rr <- function(rr, lo, hi) ifelse(is.na(rr), "Not possible", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", rr, lo, hi))
  display <- results |>
    dplyr::filter(stratification != "Index setting") |>
    dplyr::mutate(estimate = format_rr(RR, conf_low, conf_high), weight_display = unname(weight_labels[weight])) |>

  write_csv(display, "table3_transition_strata_wide.csv")
  for (domain in domains) {

  cat("\nCochran Q, IIW lag1:\n")

  # No title, subtitle or caption is embedded in the scientific image.
  # The parent row uses the same episode domain as the corresponding stratified rows.
  plot_list <- list()
  plot_colours <- c("Higher intensity" = "#b55528", "Same intensity" = "#246e8f",
    "Lower intensity" = "#674b83", "All trajectories" = "#626262")
  for (domain in domains) {

        weight_display = factor(unname(weight_labels[weight]), levels = unname(weight_labels)),

    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data, ggplot2::aes(x = RR, y = row, colour = direction)) +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "#555555", linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = conf_low, xend = conf_high, yend = row), linewidth = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(shape = stratification), size = 2.1, na.rm = TRUE) +
      ggplot2::geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(plot_data, status == "Structural zero"),
        ggplot2::aes(x = 1, label = "Not possible"), colour = "#777777", size = 2.6, family = "Arial") +

        "Higher intensity" = "Higher", "All trajectories" = "Parent setting")) +

Corrected exploratory findings and Table 3 anchors

The five-setting IIW are now imported by unique episode key from the same corrected bundle as prop_grantt_25_postrev23.ipynb. All 15 parent Table 3 estimates and confidence intervals agree with its full-precision reference. All 34 unweighted fits and all cohort/transition counts remain unchanged. The 102 supported models were fitted successfully; the 18 structural-zero rows represent three impossible combinations across two domains and three weighting schemes.

Index setting Corrected lag0 Corrected lag1 Unweighted
GP-bas 1.056 (1.030, 1.082) 1.051 (1.029, 1.074) 1.047 (1.027, 1.068)
GP-int 1.044 (1.019, 1.070) 1.036 (1.014, 1.057) 1.036 (1.016, 1.055)
GP-res 1.037 (0.995, 1.081) 1.030 (0.988, 1.075) 1.028 (0.992, 1.064)
WO-int 1.046 (0.990, 1.105) 1.039 (0.992, 1.089) 1.037 (0.994, 1.081)
WO-res 1.173 (1.109, 1.241) 1.118 (1.063, 1.176) 1.123 (1.073, 1.175)

These parent estimates replace the earlier estimates based on misassigned weights. Every subgroup comparison in this section uses the corrected parent anchor. For all episodes with corrected five-setting lag1 IIW, Q across the 12 supported joint strata is 27.28 (11 df; P=0.0042); combined intensity heterogeneity within index settings is 18.65 (7 df; P=0.0093).

The later section separately re-estimates IIW in each supported joint stratum, allowing the effect of correcting the implementation to be distinguished from the effect of changing the grouping used to estimate weights. Historical misaligned estimates appear only as labelled audit comparators there. The same covariates, endpoint, GEE specification and patient-level trajectory definitions are retained.

The corrected construction converts identifiers before ordering, aligns administrative follow-up to the package’s patient order, and joins returned weights by rn. It also uses lagfirst[1] = 0 and the recognized cluster(id) Cox special. The handoff’s 16:03 and 16:13 entries explain the previous control discrepancy; it is no longer attributed to unverified source-data changes or package drift. Administrative-censoring rows with missing baseline covariates remain omitted under the inherited specification; this limitation is documented rather than silently repaired.

These are conditional trajectory-specific associations. Robust intervals and exploratory Q statistics condition on estimated weights; they do not include uncertainty from fitting the intensity models. Parent and subgroup estimates overlap in patients, so their ratios are descriptive.

Corrected estimates, shared Table 3 validation, Cochran Q, and unweighted preservation checks.

Observed sample coverage and persistence after the first readmission

The median was 2 observed treatments (IQR 2-3; range 2-13). Of 27,445 recurrent patients, 8,425 (30.7%) had a second readmission, i.e. a third treatment; 19,020 (69.3%) had only two observed treatments. The first two treatments account for 54,890 of 67,957 episode rows (80.8%); 13,067 episode rows occur at treatment 3 or later. The fixed grouping captures the first-to-second transition, while a third treatment supplies the second transition.

Setting means the exact five-category programme/modality combination. Intensity compares basic ambulatory, intensive ambulatory and residential care, regardless of programme. Third-treatment persistence is relative to treatment 2. The primary ever-change measure includes 2->3 onward and is conditional on observing treatment 3. The strictly-after-third table includes 3->4 onward and is conditional on observing treatment 4. Counts describe any change within observed follow-up. The export also gives each count as a percentage of its complete original stratum. Zero-size strata have 0% cohort share and undefined conditional percentages.

.t0 <- Sys.time()
# Reconstruct patient-level observation and persistence; do not refit outcome models.
table3_followup <- (function() {
  started <- Sys.time()
  stopifnot(all(vapply(c("dplyr", "tidyr", "knitr", "IRdisplay"), requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)))
  reference_dir <- "output/exploratory_table3_first_readmission_20260911_125809"
  source_rdata <- "G:/My Drive/Alvacast/SISTRAT 2023/data/20241015_out/psu/psu_ndp_2025_10_02.Rdata"
  out_dir <- file.path(reference_dir, paste0("followup_support_", format(started, "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")))
  stopifnot(dir.exists(reference_dir), file.exists(source_rdata), !dir.exists(out_dir), dir.create(out_dir))
  protected <- c("time_varying_setting_sensitivity_2026_09_08.ipynb", "time_varying_setting_sensitivity_2026_09_03.qmd",
    "_doc/AJE/final/AJE-01195-2025-R3_clean_copy.docx", file.path(reference_dir,
      c("estimates_long.csv", "cochran_q_heterogeneity.csv", "model_diagnostics.csv", "aggregate_results.rds", "analysis.R")))
  protected_md5 <- tools::md5sum(protected)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(protected_md5))
  cat("Follow-up output directory:", out_dir, "\n")
  log_connection <- file(file.path(out_dir, "followup_log.txt"), open = "wt")
  sink_depth <- sink.number()
  sink(log_connection, split = TRUE)
  on.exit({ while (sink.number() > sink_depth) sink(); close(log_connection) }, add = TRUE)
  checks <- list()
  check <- function(label, ok, detail = "") {
    checks[[length(checks) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(check = label, passed = isTRUE(ok), detail = detail)
    if (!isTRUE(ok)) stop("Failed check: ", label, "; ", detail)
    cat("PASS:", label, if (nzchar(detail)) paste0(" | ", detail) else "", "\n")
  }
  write_csv <- function(x, name) utils::write.csv(x, file.path(out_dir, name), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  ws <- new.env(parent = baseenv())
  loaded <- base::load(source_rdata, envir = ws)
  check("Both source objects exist", all(c("dat_with_weights_stab_cons", "SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient") %in% loaded))
  required <- c("hash_key", "treatment", "adm_date_rec2", "disch_date_rec6", "plan_type_corr", "plan_type_mod")
  check("Required source columns", all(required %in% names(ws$dat_with_weights_stab_cons)))
  dat <- dplyr::select(ws$dat_with_weights_stab_cons, dplyr::all_of(required)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(hash_key, adm_date_rec2, disch_date_rec6)
  registry <- ws$SISTRAT_clean_drop_patient |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$hash_key %in% .env$dat$hash_key) |>
    dplyr::select(hash_key, adm_date_rec2, disch_date_rec6, plan_type_corr) |>
    dplyr::arrange(hash_key, adm_date_rec2, disch_date_rec6)
  rm(ws)
  invisible(gc())
  check("Recurrent cohort dimensions", nrow(dat) == 67957L && dplyr::n_distinct(dat$hash_key) == 27445L)
  check("Complete fields and unique chronology", !anyNA(dat) && !anyDuplicated(dat[c("hash_key", "treatment")]) &&
    !anyDuplicated(dat[c("hash_key", "adm_date_rec2", "disch_date_rec6")]))
  check("Registry episode alignment", nrow(registry) == nrow(dat) && identical(registry$hash_key, dat$hash_key) &&
    identical(registry$adm_date_rec2, dat$adm_date_rec2) && identical(registry$disch_date_rec6, dat$disch_date_rec6) &&
    identical(as.character(registry$plan_type_corr), as.character(dat$plan_type_corr)))
  settings <- c("GP-bas", "GP-int", "GP-res", "WO-int", "WO-res")
  directions <- c("Higher intensity", "Same intensity", "Lower intensity")
  map <- stats::setNames(rep(settings, 2L), c("pg-pab", "pg-pai", "pg-pr", "m-pai", "m-pr",
    "GP basic ambulatory", "GP intensive ambulatory", "GP residential", "WO intensive ambulatory", "WO residential"))
  intensity <- c("GP-bas" = 1L, "GP-int" = 2L, "GP-res" = 3L, "WO-int" = 2L, "WO-res" = 3L)
  dat <- dat |>
    dplyr::mutate(current = unname(map[as.character(plan_type_corr)]), origin = unname(map[as.character(plan_type_mod)]),
      current_intensity = unname(intensity[current])) |>
    dplyr::group_by(hash_key) |>
    dplyr::mutate(episode_rank = dplyr::row_number(), n_treatments = dplyr::n(),
      changed_setting = current != dplyr::lag(current), changed_intensity = current_intensity != dplyr::lag(current_intensity)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
  check("Known settings and all patients recurrent", !anyNA(dat[c("current", "origin", "current_intensity")]) && all(dat$n_treatments >= 2L))
  fixed_check <- dat |> dplyr::group_by(hash_key) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_origin = dplyr::n_distinct(origin), agree = origin[1L] == current[1L], .groups = "drop")
  check("Fixed index setting", all(fixed_check$n_origin == 1L) && all(fixed_check$agree))
  patients <- dat |> dplyr::group_by(hash_key) |>
    dplyr::summarise(origin = origin[1L], second = current[2L], treatments = dplyr::n(),
      third_observed = dplyr::n() >= 3L, fourth_observed = dplyr::n() >= 4L,
      third_same_setting = if (dplyr::n() >= 3L) current[3L] == current[2L] else NA,
      third_same_intensity = if (dplyr::n() >= 3L) current_intensity[3L] == current_intensity[2L] else NA,
      any_setting_change_k3plus = if (dplyr::n() >= 3L) any(changed_setting[episode_rank >= 3L]) else NA,
      any_intensity_change_k3plus = if (dplyr::n() >= 3L) any(changed_intensity[episode_rank >= 3L]) else NA,
      any_setting_change_k4plus = if (dplyr::n() >= 4L) any(changed_setting[episode_rank >= 4L]) else NA,
      any_intensity_change_k4plus = if (dplyr::n() >= 4L) any(changed_intensity[episode_rank >= 4L]) else NA,
      same_third_then_setting_change = if (dplyr::n() >= 3L) current[3L] == current[2L] && any(changed_setting[episode_rank >= 4L]) else NA,
      same_third_then_intensity_change = if (dplyr::n() >= 3L) current_intensity[3L] == current_intensity[2L] && any(changed_intensity[episode_rank >= 4L]) else NA,
      # Independent endpoint-reference calculation detects any move, including returns.
      reference_setting_change = if (dplyr::n() >= 3L) any(current[episode_rank >= 3L] != current[2L]) else NA,
      reference_intensity_change = if (dplyr::n() >= 3L) any(current_intensity[episode_rank >= 3L] != current_intensity[2L]) else NA,
      reference_setting_change_k4 = if (dplyr::n() >= 4L) any(current[episode_rank >= 4L] != current[3L]) else NA,
      reference_intensity_change_k4 = if (dplyr::n() >= 4L) any(current_intensity[episode_rank >= 4L] != current_intensity[3L]) else NA,
      .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(delta = unname(intensity[second] - intensity[origin]),
      direction = dplyr::case_when(delta > 0 ~ directions[1L], delta < 0 ~ directions[3L], TRUE ~ directions[2L]))
  check("One trajectory summary per patient", nrow(patients) == 27445L && !anyDuplicated(patients$hash_key) && sum(patients$treatments) == 67957L)
  check("Independent change algorithms agree including returns", identical(patients$any_setting_change_k3plus, patients$reference_setting_change) &&
    identical(patients$any_intensity_change_k3plus, patients$reference_intensity_change) &&
    identical(patients$any_setting_change_k4plus, patients$reference_setting_change_k4) &&
    identical(patients$any_intensity_change_k4plus, patients$reference_intensity_change_k4))
  check("Unobserved third and fourth visits remain missing", all(is.na(patients$third_same_setting) == !patients$third_observed) &&
    all(is.na(patients$any_setting_change_k3plus) == !patients$third_observed) &&
    all(is.na(patients$any_setting_change_k4plus) == !patients$fourth_observed))
  first_counts <- patients |> dplyr::count(origin, second, name = "new_n")
  ref_pairs <- utils::read.csv(file.path(reference_dir, "first_readmission_matrix_validation.csv"))
  pair_check <- dplyr::full_join(first_counts, ref_pairs[c("origin", "second", "patients")], by = c("origin", "second"))
  check("All 25 first-readmission counts unchanged", nrow(pair_check) == 25L && !anyNA(pair_check) && all(pair_check$new_n == pair_check$patients))
  write_csv(pair_check, "first_readmission_validation.csv")
  count_distribution <- patients |> dplyr::count(treatments, name = "patients") |>
    dplyr::mutate(pct_cohort = 100 * patients / sum(patients), cumulative_patients = cumsum(patients),
      episodes = treatments * patients)
  check("Treatment count distribution sums", sum(count_distribution$patients) == 27445L && sum(count_distribution$episodes) == 67957L &&
    sum(patients$treatments - 2L) == 13067L && sum(dat$episode_rank >= 3L) == 13067L)
  write_csv(count_distribution, "treatment_count_distribution.csv")
  summarise_group <- function(x) {
    data.frame(patients = nrow(x), episodes = sum(x$treatments),
      exactly_two = sum(x$treatments == 2L), third_observed = sum(x$third_observed), fourth_observed = sum(x$fourth_observed),
      third_same_setting = sum(x$third_same_setting, na.rm = TRUE), third_same_intensity = sum(x$third_same_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
      third_changed_setting = sum(!x$third_same_setting, na.rm = TRUE), third_changed_intensity = sum(!x$third_same_intensity, na.rm = TRUE),
      any_setting_change_k3plus = sum(x$any_setting_change_k3plus, na.rm = TRUE),
      any_intensity_change_k3plus = sum(x$any_intensity_change_k3plus, na.rm = TRUE),
      no_setting_change_k3plus = sum(!x$any_setting_change_k3plus, na.rm = TRUE),
      no_intensity_change_k3plus = sum(!x$any_intensity_change_k3plus, na.rm = TRUE),
      any_setting_change_k4plus = sum(x$any_setting_change_k4plus, na.rm = TRUE),
      any_intensity_change_k4plus = sum(x$any_intensity_change_k4plus, na.rm = TRUE),
      same_third_then_setting_change = sum(x$same_third_then_setting_change, na.rm = TRUE),
      same_third_then_intensity_change = sum(x$same_third_then_intensity_change, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_treatments = if (nrow(x)) stats::median(x$treatments) else NA_real_,
      q1_treatments = if (nrow(x)) unname(stats::quantile(x$treatments, .25)) else NA_real_,
      q3_treatments = if (nrow(x)) unname(stats::quantile(x$treatments, .75)) else NA_real_,
      max_treatments = if (nrow(x)) max(x$treatments) else NA_real_)
  }
  grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(origin = settings, direction = directions)
  by_stratum <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
    x <- patients[patients$origin == grid$origin[i] & patients$direction == grid$direction[i], ]
    cbind(grid[i, ], summarise_group(x))
  }))
  all_row <- cbind(data.frame(origin = "All settings", direction = "All combinations"), summarise_group(patients))
  summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_row, by_stratum)
  percentage <- function(n, denominator) {
    result <- 100 * n / denominator
    result[!is.finite(result)] <- NA_real_
    result
  }
  origin_n <- table(patients$origin)
  summary$origin_patients <- c(nrow(patients), unname(as.integer(origin_n[by_stratum$origin])))
  summary$pct_cohort <- percentage(summary$patients, nrow(patients))
  summary$pct_origin <- percentage(summary$patients, summary$origin_patients)
  # The stratum's share of the cohort/origin is zero for impossible cells; conditional percentages are undefined.
  summary$structural_zero <- summary$patients == 0L
  check("Cohort shares use the full scalar denominator without recycling", length(summary$pct_cohort) == nrow(summary) &&
    all(abs(summary$pct_cohort - 100 * summary$patients / 27445L) < 1e-10) &&
    abs(sum(summary$pct_cohort[-1L]) - 100) < 1e-10 && all(summary$pct_cohort[summary$structural_zero] == 0))
  for (name in c("exactly_two", "third_observed", "fourth_observed")) summary[[paste0(name, "_pct_stratum")]] <- percentage(summary[[name]], summary$patients)
  k3_metrics <- c("third_same_setting", "third_same_intensity", "third_changed_setting", "third_changed_intensity",
    "any_setting_change_k3plus", "any_intensity_change_k3plus", "no_setting_change_k3plus", "no_intensity_change_k3plus",
    "same_third_then_setting_change", "same_third_then_intensity_change")
  for (name in k3_metrics) {
    summary[[paste0(name, "_pct_third_observed")]] <- percentage(summary[[name]], summary$third_observed)
    summary[[paste0(name, "_pct_stratum")]] <- percentage(summary[[name]], summary$patients)
  }
  for (name in c("any_setting_change_k4plus", "any_intensity_change_k4plus")) {
    summary[[paste0(name, "_pct_fourth_observed")]] <- percentage(summary[[name]], summary$fourth_observed)
    summary[[paste0(name, "_pct_stratum")]] <- percentage(summary[[name]], summary$patients)
  }
  check("Every count partitions correctly", all(summary$exactly_two + summary$third_observed == summary$patients) &&
    all(summary$third_same_setting + summary$third_changed_setting == summary$third_observed) &&
    all(summary$third_same_intensity + summary$third_changed_intensity == summary$third_observed) &&
    all(summary$no_setting_change_k3plus + summary$any_setting_change_k3plus == summary$third_observed) &&
    all(summary$no_intensity_change_k3plus + summary$any_intensity_change_k3plus == summary$third_observed))
  check("Setting and intensity event containment", all(summary$third_same_setting <= summary$third_same_intensity) &&
    all(summary$any_intensity_change_k3plus <= summary$any_setting_change_k3plus) &&
    all(summary$third_changed_setting <= summary$any_setting_change_k3plus) &&
    all(summary$third_changed_intensity <= summary$any_intensity_change_k3plus) &&
    all(summary$any_setting_change_k4plus <= summary$fourth_observed) && all(summary$fourth_observed <= summary$third_observed))
  check("Third-same then later-change identities", all(summary$any_setting_change_k3plus ==
      summary$third_changed_setting + summary$same_third_then_setting_change) &&
    all(summary$any_intensity_change_k3plus == summary$third_changed_intensity + summary$same_third_then_intensity_change))
  count_columns <- names(summary)[match("patients", names(summary)):match("same_third_then_intensity_change", names(summary))]
  check("Overall counts equal sums of strata", all(vapply(count_columns, function(name) summary[[name]][1L] == sum(summary[[name]][-1L]), logical(1))))
  ref_support <- utils::read.csv(file.path(reference_dir, "cohort_support_15_strata.csv"))
  support_check <- dplyr::full_join(by_stratum, ref_support[c("origin", "direction", "patients", "episodes")],
    by = c("origin", "direction"), suffix = c("_new", "_reference"))
  check("Original 15-stratum sample sizes reproduce", nrow(support_check) == 15L && all(support_check$patients_new == support_check$patients_reference) &&
    all(support_check$episodes_new == support_check$episodes_reference) && sum(by_stratum$patients == 0L) == 3L)
  write_csv(summary, "followup_counts_and_percentages.csv")
  write_csv(support_check, "cohort_size_validation.csv")
  fmt <- function(n, denominator) ifelse(denominator > 0, sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", format(n, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), 100 * n / denominator), "Not applicable")
  size_table <- data.frame(`Index setting` = summary$origin, `First-readmission intensity` = summary$direction,
    `Patients` = format(summary$patients, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE), `% of cohort` = sprintf("%.1f", summary$pct_cohort),
    `% of index setting` = sprintf("%.1f", summary$pct_origin), `Exactly 2 treatments, n (%)` = fmt(summary$exactly_two, summary$patients),
    `Third treatment observed, n (%)` = fmt(summary$third_observed, summary$patients),
    `Fourth treatment observed, n (%)` = fmt(summary$fourth_observed, summary$patients), check.names = FALSE)
  persistence_table <- data.frame(`Index setting` = summary$origin, `First-readmission intensity` = summary$direction,
    `Patients with third treatment` = format(summary$third_observed, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
    `Third: same setting, n (%)` = fmt(summary$third_same_setting, summary$third_observed),
    `Third: same intensity, n (%)` = fmt(summary$third_same_intensity, summary$third_observed),
    `Any setting change from third onward, n (%)` = fmt(summary$any_setting_change_k3plus, summary$third_observed),
    `Any intensity change from third onward, n (%)` = fmt(summary$any_intensity_change_k3plus, summary$third_observed), check.names = FALSE)
  later_table <- data.frame(`Index setting` = summary$origin, `First-readmission intensity` = summary$direction,
    `Patients with fourth treatment` = format(summary$fourth_observed, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE),
    `Any setting change after third, n (%)` = fmt(summary$any_setting_change_k4plus, summary$fourth_observed),
    `Any intensity change after third, n (%)` = fmt(summary$any_intensity_change_k4plus, summary$fourth_observed), check.names = FALSE)
  write_csv(size_table, "combination_sample_sizes_display.csv")
  write_csv(persistence_table, "third_treatment_and_later_persistence_display.csv")
  write_csv(later_table, "strictly_after_third_display.csv")
  show_table <- function(x, caption) IRdisplay::display_html(as.character(knitr::kable(x, format = "html", caption = caption, row.names = FALSE)))
  show_table(count_distribution, "Observed treatment-count distribution in the recurrent cohort.")
  show_table(size_table, "Sample support. Visit-count percentages use all patients in each original combination; the first row uses the full recurrent cohort.")
  show_table(persistence_table, "Third treatment versus second; any adjacent change from second to third onward. Percentages use patients observed at a third treatment within each combination.")
  show_table(later_table, "Strictly after third: changes on third-to-fourth and later transitions. Percentages use patients observed at a fourth treatment.")
  notes <- c("Observed follow-up and persistence for fixed index x first-readmission-intensity combinations",
    sprintf("Recurrent cohort: %s patients / %s treatments. Median %.1f; IQR %.1f-%.1f; range 2-%d.",
      format(nrow(patients), big.mark = ","), format(nrow(dat), big.mark = ","), stats::median(patients$treatments),
      stats::quantile(patients$treatments, .25), stats::quantile(patients$treatments, .75), max(patients$treatments)),
    "The fixed grouping uses one transition, first to second treatment. Second readmission means third treatment, which supplies the second observed transition.",
    "Exact setting uses all five programme/modality combinations; intensity uses basic ambulatory=1, intensive ambulatory=2, residential=3. Same exact setting implies same intensity, but the reverse need not hold.",
    "Third-treatment persistence compares treatment 3 with treatment 2, not with the index. Any change from third onward includes 2->3, 3->4, and every later adjacent pair. Moves followed by returns still count as a change.",
    "Third-treatment persistence and ever-change counts overlap: a patient may remain at treatment 3 and change at a later treatment. Their percentages should not be added. Counts of same at third then changed later are exported explicitly.",
    "Primary conditional percentages use patients observed at treatment 3. Relative to the complete stratum, the same counts and their percentages are also exported. Patients observed only twice are ineligible for third-treatment persistence, not classified as stable.",
    "The supplementary strictly-after-third table excludes 2->3 and considers 3->4 onward, with patients observed at treatment 4 as its denominator.",
    "Zero-size combinations are structurally impossible. Their cohort share is 0%, while persistence and follow-up percentages conditional on these empty groups are undefined.",
    "Counts describe observed registry trajectories in the recurrent cohort. Lack of another recorded treatment is not evidence of stable setting, successful completion or no need for care. Observation periods and opportunities for readmission differ; these tables describe sample coverage rather than establish external generalizability.",
    "No outcome model or inverse-intensity weight was re-estimated. No identifiers or individual trajectories are exported.")
  writeLines(notes, file.path(out_dir, "definitions_and_denominators.txt"), useBytes = TRUE)
  check("Existing model and main analysis files unchanged", identical(unname(tools::md5sum(protected)), unname(protected_md5)))
  write_csv(dplyr::bind_rows(checks), "followup_verification_checks.csv")
  provenance <- c(source_rdata, protected, file.path(reference_dir, c("cohort_support_15_strata.csv", "first_readmission_matrix_validation.csv")))
  write_csv(data.frame(path = provenance, md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(provenance)), bytes = file.info(provenance)$size), "followup_source_provenance.csv")
  saveRDS(list(summary = summary, count_distribution = count_distribution, size_table = size_table,
    persistence_table = persistence_table, later_table = later_table, checks = dplyr::bind_rows(checks), notes = notes), file.path(out_dir, "followup_aggregates.rds"))
  cat(notes[2L], "\n")
  cat(sprintf("[follow-up support] elapsed: %.2f min\n", as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), started, units = "mins"))))
  list(out_dir = out_dir, reference_dir = reference_dir, summary = summary, distribution = count_distribution,
    tables = list(sizes = size_table, persistence = persistence_table, strictly_later = later_table), notes = notes)
})()
cat(sprintf("[table3-followup-support] elapsed: %.2f min\n", as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .t0, units = "mins"))))

Among the 8,425 patients with a third treatment, 4,216 (50.0%) remained in the same exact setting and 4,465 (53.0%) remained at the same intensity as at treatment 2. Nevertheless, 4,940 (58.6%) had at least one setting change and 4,702 (55.8%) at least one intensity change on 2->3 or any later adjacent transition. These measures overlap: 731 patients stayed in the same setting at treatment 3 and changed later; 742 stayed at the same intensity at treatment 3 and changed later. Moves followed by returns count as changes.

The share observed at a third treatment varies from 25.4% to 48.4% across supported combinations. In WO intensive/lower intensity, only 56 of 190 patients reach a third treatment and 16 reach a fourth. These counts support interpretation of the sampled recurrent-care trajectories; they do not establish external generalizability or uniform follow-up. Patients without another observed treatment are not classified as stable. Remaining at the third treatment does not imply remaining in that setting throughout later care.

Complete aggregate counts and definitions.

The lag0 and lag1 columns use the corrected five-setting bundle; unweighted estimates retain the same covariate adjustment and are unchanged. These tables reshape the corrected estimates from the preceding analysis chunk.

# Use the verified estimates from the existing private analysis; no model fitting.
table3_weighting_layouts <- (function(reference_dir, out_dir) {
  stopifnot(all(vapply(c("dplyr", "tidyr", "knitr", "IRdisplay"), requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)))
  estimate_file <- file.path(reference_dir, "estimates_long.csv")
  before_md5 <- tools::md5sum(estimate_file)
  estimates <- utils::read.csv(estimate_file)
  all_episodes <- dplyr::filter(estimates, domain == "All episodes")
  settings <- c("GP-bas", "GP-int", "GP-res", "WO-int", "WO-res")
  weight_labels <- c("w0_tr" = "IIW lag0", "w1_tr" = "IIW lag1", "unweighted" = "Unweighted")
  columns <- c("Corrected Table 3", "Higher intensity", "Same intensity", "Lower intensity")
  layouts <- list()
  for (weight_value in names(weight_labels)) {
    rows <- dplyr::filter(all_episodes, weight == weight_value) |>
      dplyr::mutate(column = ifelse(direction == "All trajectories", "Corrected Table 3", direction),
        `Index setting` = factor(origin, levels = settings),
        estimate = ifelse(status == "Structural zero", "Not possible", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", RR, conf_low, conf_high)))
    stopifnot(nrow(rows) == 20L, !anyDuplicated(rows[c("origin", "column")]), sum(rows$status == "Structural zero") == 3L,
      all(rows$column %in% columns), all(is.finite(rows$RR[rows$status != "Structural zero"])))
    layout <- rows |> dplyr::select(`Index setting`, column, estimate) |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = column, values_from = estimate) |>
      dplyr::arrange(`Index setting`) |> dplyr::select(`Index setting`, dplyr::all_of(columns))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) stopifnot(identical(as.character(layout[match(rows$origin[i], as.character(layout$`Index setting`)), rows$column[i]][[1L]]), rows$estimate[i]))
    utils::write.csv(layout, file.path(out_dir, paste0("table3_comparison_", weight_value, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    IRdisplay::display_html(as.character(knitr::kable(layout, format = "html", row.names = FALSE,
      caption = paste0(weight_labels[weight_value], ": adjusted PSUD RR (95% CI) for non-completion; all episodes."))))
    layouts[[weight_value]] <- layout
  }
  stopifnot(identical(unname(tools::md5sum(estimate_file)), unname(before_md5)))
  cat("PASS: all 60 comparison cells reproduce the existing all-episode model output; all three columns of weighting schemes remain covariate-adjusted.\n")
  layouts
})(table3_exploration$out_dir, table3_exploration$out_dir)

Corrected IIW within 15 transition strata

The fixed stratum is index setting x intensity change from treatment 1 to treatment 2. There are 12 observed combinations and three structural zeros. The shared iiw_correction_2026_09_11.R module calls IrregLong::iiw.weights with the established intensity covariates and both initialization variants.

The corrected implementation coerces patient IDs before sorting, orders maxfu explicitly to match the package, and joins weights back by rn. It uses a zero first time lag and the recognized unqualified cluster(id) Cox special. All observed episodes must enter the intensity models. The existing omission of administrative-censoring rows is recorded without introducing a new model.

Raw weights are combined across groups and truncated once at the pooled 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles, consistently with the corrected postrev23 workflow. The five-setting comparison uses the exact shared corrected bundle; no new five-setting fit is substituted. We retain historical misaligned weights solely as labelled audit comparators. The _stab object names are inherited; no separate numerator model is fitted.

Code 
.t0 <- Sys.time()
# Use the same corrected IrregLong implementation and five-setting bundle as postrev23.
iiw15 <- (function() {
  stopifnot(all(vapply(c("dplyr", "tidyr", "knitr", "IRdisplay"), requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)))
  stopifnot(exists("table3_exploration"), file.exists("iiw_correction_2026_09_11.R"))
  shared <- new.env(parent = environment())
  sys.source("iiw_correction_2026_09_11.R", envir = shared)
  previous_dir <- "output/exploratory_table3_first_readmission_20260911_125809"
  out_dir <- file.path(table3_exploration$out_dir, "corrected_iiw_15_strata")
  stopifnot(!dir.exists(out_dir), dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE))
  checks <- list()
  check <- function(label, passed, detail = "") {
    checks[[length(checks) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(check = label, passed = isTRUE(passed), detail = detail)
    utils::write.csv(dplyr::bind_rows(checks), file.path(out_dir, "weight_verification_checks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    if (!isTRUE(passed)) stop("Failed check: ", label, "; ", detail)
    cat("PASS:", label, if (nzchar(detail)) paste0(" | ", detail) else "", "\n")
  }
  write_csv <- function(x, name) utils::write.csv(x, file.path(out_dir, name), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  dat <- table3_exploration$dat
  settings <- c("GP-bas", "GP-int", "GP-res", "WO-int", "WO-res")
  directions <- c("Higher intensity", "Same intensity", "Lower intensity")
  dat$joint <- paste(dat$origin, dat$direction, sep = " | ")
  grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(origin = settings, direction = directions) |>
    dplyr::mutate(joint = paste(origin, direction, sep = " | "))
  cohort <- dat |> dplyr::group_by(origin, direction) |>
    dplyr::summarise(patients = dplyr::n_distinct(id), episodes = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
  cohort <- grid |> dplyr::left_join(cohort, by = c("origin", "direction")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(patients, episodes), ~tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0L)), structural_zero = patients == 0L)
  expected <- utils::read.csv(file.path(previous_dir, "cohort_support_15_strata.csv"))
  same <- dplyr::full_join(cohort, expected[c("origin", "direction", "patients", "episodes")],
    by = c("origin", "direction"), suffix = c("", "_previous"))
  check("All fifteen stratum counts remain unchanged", nrow(same) == 15L && !anyNA(same) &&
    all(same$patients == same$patients_previous) && all(same$episodes == same$episodes_previous) && sum(cohort$structural_zero) == 3L)
  check("Joint group is fixed once per patient", nrow(dplyr::distinct(dat, id, joint)) == 27445L)
  write_csv(cohort, "cohort_support_15_strata.csv")
  # Keep historical misaligned weights only as clearly labelled audit comparators.
  dat$v23_five_settings_lag0 <- dat$w0_tr
  dat$v23_five_settings_lag1 <- dat$w1_tr
  dat$w0_tr <- dat$historical_w0_tr
  dat$w1_tr <- dat$historical_w1_tr
  corrected_joint <- shared$iiw_corrected_build(dat, group_col = "joint",
    output_dir = file.path(out_dir, "intensity_fits"), cohort_label = "Recurrent cohort: index setting x first-readmission intensity", cap_passes = 1L)
  aligned <- match(dat$rn, corrected_joint$data$rn)
  check("Corrected joint weights return every unique episode", !anyDuplicated(corrected_joint$data$rn) &&
    setequal(dat$rn, corrected_joint$data$rn) && !anyNA(aligned) &&
    identical(dat$hash_key, corrected_joint$data$hash_key[aligned]))
  dat$joint_15_strata_lag0 <- corrected_joint$data$w0_tr[aligned]
  dat$joint_15_strata_lag1 <- corrected_joint$data$w1_tr[aligned]
  check("All four corrected weight vectors are finite and positive", all(vapply(dat[c("v23_five_settings_lag0",
    "v23_five_settings_lag1", "joint_15_strata_lag0", "joint_15_strata_lag1")], function(w) all(is.finite(w) & w > 0), logical(1))))
  check("Exactly 24 supported joint-stratum intensity models", length(corrected_joint$fits0) == 12L && length(corrected_joint$fits1) == 12L)
  write_csv(corrected_joint$diagnostics, "intensity_model_diagnostics.csv")
  write_csv(corrected_joint$weight_summary, "shared_weight_summary.csv")
  weight_diagnostics <- list()
  for (scheme in c("v23_five_settings", "joint_15_strata")) for (lag in c("lag0", "lag1")) {
    for (group in cohort$joint[!cohort$structural_zero]) {
      rows <- dat$joint == group
      w <- dat[[paste(scheme, lag, sep = "_")]][rows]
      old <- dat[[if (lag == "lag0") "w0_tr" else "w1_tr"]][rows]
      five <- dat[[paste0("v23_five_settings_", lag)]][rows]
      weight_diagnostics[[length(weight_diagnostics) + 1L]] <- data.frame(scheme = scheme, lag = lag, group = group,
        patients = dplyr::n_distinct(dat$id[rows]), episodes = sum(rows),
        capped_min = min(w), capped_max = max(w), capped_mean = mean(w),
        capped_ess = sum(w)^2 / sum(w^2), capped_ess_pct = 100 * sum(w)^2 / sum(w^2) / length(w),
        correlation_with_historical_misaligned = stats::cor(w, old), correlation_with_corrected_five = stats::cor(w, five))
    }
  }
  weight_diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(weight_diagnostics)
  write_csv(weight_diagnostics, "weight_distribution_diagnostics.csv")
  coefficients <- list()
  for (lag in c("lag0", "lag1")) {
    fits <- corrected_joint[[if (lag == "lag0") "fits0" else "fits1"]]
    for (group in names(fits)) {
      fit <- fits[[group]]$m
      coefficients[[length(coefficients) + 1L]] <- data.frame(group = group, lag = lag,
        term = names(stats::coef(fit)), coefficient = unname(stats::coef(fit)), robust_se = sqrt(diag(stats::vcov(fit))))
    }
  }
  write_csv(dplyr::bind_rows(coefficients), "intensity_model_coefficients.csv")
  saveRDS(dat, file.path(out_dir, "analysis_frame_with_reestimated_weights.rds"))
  source_files <- c(table3_exploration$corrected_bundle_path, "iiw_correction_2026_09_11.R",
    file.path(previous_dir, c("analysis.R", "estimates_long.csv", "cohort_support_15_strata.csv")))
  write_csv(data.frame(path = source_files, md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(source_files)), bytes = file.info(source_files)$size), "source_provenance.csv")
  utils::capture.output(utils::sessionInfo(), file = file.path(out_dir, "session_info.txt"))
  display <- weight_diagnostics |> dplyr::filter(scheme == "joint_15_strata") |>
    dplyr::transmute(Stratum = group, Lag = lag, Patients = patients, Episodes = episodes,
      Minimum = capped_min, Maximum = capped_max, `ESS (%)` = capped_ess_pct,
      `Correlation with corrected five-setting IIW` = correlation_with_corrected_five)
  IRdisplay::display_html(as.character(knitr::kable(display, format = "html", digits = 3,
    caption = "Corrected IIW by index setting x first-readmission intensity; the five-setting comparator uses the shared postrev23 bundle.")))
  IRdisplay::display_html(as.character(knitr::kable(corrected_joint$diagnostics, format = "html", digits = 3,
    caption = "Corrected intensity-model diagnostics. Administrative-censoring rows omitted because baseline covariates are missing remain explicitly documented.")))
  cat("Fitted 24 corrected joint-stratum intensity models; imported the corrected five-setting bundle by episode key.\n")
  list(out_dir = out_dir, previous_dir = previous_dir, dat = dat, grid = grid, cohort = cohort,
    settings = settings, directions = directions, clean_weights = function(w) {
      stopifnot(all(is.finite(w) & w > 0)); w / mean(w)
    }, weight_diagnostics = weight_diagnostics, intensity_diagnostics = corrected_joint$diagnostics)
})()
cat(sprintf("[corrected joint-stratum IIW] elapsed: %.2f min\n", as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .t0, units = "mins"))))

Outcome comparisons and heterogeneity

The following chunk reuses the established modified-Poisson GEE and Cochran Q functions from the original exploratory analysis. Outcome, covariates, working independence and patient-robust intervals are unchanged. Valid weights are mean-normalized within each GEE fit, as in postrev23.

Three explicitly labelled audit schemes are evaluated: historical misaligned five-setting IIW, corrected five-setting IIW, and corrected joint-stratum IIW. Corrected Table 3 anchors are used in the higher/same/lower layouts. Historical controls must reproduce the previous outputs, and corrected five-setting controls must reproduce the refreshed main exploration. The figures compare the two corrected strategies.

The two episode domains use the same fixed patient groups. Q compares disjoint patient strata using unrounded log-RRs and robust variances; no independence test is made between overlapping parent and subgroup estimates. Tests and intervals condition on estimated weights and are exploratory.

Code 
.t0 <- Sys.time()
# Requires `iiw15` from the preceding source-weight chunk; no changes to Table 3's GEE specification.
iiw15_results <- (function(iiw15) {
  stopifnot(all(vapply(c("dplyr", "tidyr", "geepack", "ggplot2", "knitr", "IRdisplay"), requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)))
  out_dir <- iiw15$out_dir
  dat <- iiw15$dat
  settings <- iiw15$settings; directions <- iiw15$directions; grid <- iiw15$grid
  checks <- list()
  check <- function(label, passed, detail = "") {
    checks[[length(checks) + 1L]] <<- data.frame(check = label, passed = isTRUE(passed), detail = detail)
    utils::write.csv(dplyr::bind_rows(checks), file.path(out_dir, "outcome_verification_checks.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    if (!isTRUE(passed)) stop("Failed check: ", label, "; ", detail)
    cat("PASS:", label, if (nzchar(detail)) paste0(" | ", detail) else "", "\n")
  }
  write_csv <- function(x, filename) utils::write.csv(x, file.path(out_dir, filename), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  previous_code <- parse(file = file.path(iiw15$previous_dir, "analysis.R"))
  assignments <- list()
  wanted <- c("base_terms", "full_formula", "reduce_formula", "fit_one", "cochran_q")
  prior_analysis <- Filter(function(x) is.call(x) && identical(x[[1L]], as.name("<-")) &&
    identical(x[[2L]], as.name("table3_exploration")), as.list(previous_code))
  stopifnot(length(prior_analysis) == 1L)
  prior_function <- prior_analysis[[1L]][[3L]][[1L]][[2L]]
  stopifnot(identical(prior_function[[1L]], as.name("function")))
  prior_body <- as.list(prior_function[[3L]])
  for (nm in wanted) {
    selected <- Filter(function(x) is.call(x) && identical(x[[1L]], as.name("<-")) &&
      identical(x[[2L]], as.name(nm)), prior_body)
    stopifnot(length(selected) == 1L)
    assignments[[nm]] <- selected[[1L]]
  }
  check("All five prior GEE/Q definitions located", setequal(names(assignments), wanted))
  for (nm in wanted) eval(assignments[[nm]], envir = environment())
  check("Previous GEE and Q functions reused verbatim", all(vapply(c("reduce_formula", "fit_one", "cochran_q"), function(nm)
    identical(body(get(nm)), assignments[[nm]][[3L]][[3L]]) && identical(formals(get(nm)), assignments[[nm]][[3L]][[2L]]), logical(1))))
  diagnostics <- list(); q_checks <- numeric(); results <- list()
  domains <- c("All episodes", "Readmissions only")
  schemes <- c("stored", "v23_five_settings", "joint_15_strata")
  scheme_labels <- c(stored = "Historical misaligned IIW", v23_five_settings = "Corrected five-setting IIW", joint_15_strata = "Corrected joint-stratum IIW")
  do_fit <- function(sub, domain, stratification, origin, direction, lag, scheme) {
    weight <- if (lag == "lag0") "w0_tr" else "w1_tr"
    column <- if (scheme == "stored") weight else paste(scheme, lag, sep = "_")
    # Source clean_weights normalizes each outcome fit; valid weights require no replacements.
    if (nrow(sub)) {
      stopifnot(all(is.finite(sub[[column]]) & sub[[column]] > 0))
      sub$.analysis_weight <- iiw15$clean_weights(sub[[column]])
    }
    n_before <- length(diagnostics)
    ans <- fit_one(sub, domain, stratification, origin, direction, ".analysis_weight")
    ans$weight <- weight; ans$lag <- lag; ans$scheme <- scheme
    if (length(diagnostics) > n_before) {
      jj <- length(diagnostics)
      diagnostics[[jj]]$weight <<- weight
      diagnostics[[jj]]$lag <<- lag
      diagnostics[[jj]]$scheme <<- scheme
    }
    ans
  }
  for (domain in domains) {
    dd <- if (domain == "All episodes") dat else dat[dat$episode_rank >= 2L, , drop = FALSE]
    for (scheme in schemes) for (lag in c("lag0", "lag1")) {
      if (scheme != "joint_15_strata") for (origin in settings) results[[length(results) + 1L]] <-
        do_fit(dd[dd$origin == origin, , drop = FALSE], domain, "Index setting", origin, "All trajectories", lag, scheme)
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid))) results[[length(results) + 1L]] <-
        do_fit(dd[dd$origin == grid$origin[i] & dd$direction == grid$direction[i], , drop = FALSE], domain,
          "Index x first-readmission intensity", grid$origin[i], grid$direction[i], lag, scheme)
      cat("Completed outcome fits:", domain, scheme, lag, "\n")
    }
  }
  results <- dplyr::bind_rows(results); diagnostics <- dplyr::bind_rows(diagnostics)
  write_csv(results, "estimates_long.csv"); write_csv(diagnostics, "outcome_model_diagnostics.csv")
  check("All 184 supported outcome models estimated", nrow(results) == 220L &&
    sum(results$status == "Structural zero") == 36L && nrow(diagnostics) == 184L &&
    all(results$status %in% c("Estimated", "Estimated with warning", "Structural zero")))
  prior <- utils::read.csv(file.path(iiw15$previous_dir, "estimates_long.csv"))
  validation <- dplyr::filter(results, scheme == "stored", status != "Structural zero") |>
    dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::filter(prior, weight != "unweighted", status != "Structural zero") |>
      dplyr::select(domain, stratification, origin, direction, weight, RR, conf_low, conf_high, n_rows, n_patients),
      by = c("domain", "stratification", "origin", "direction", "weight"), suffix = c("", "_prior")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(max_abs_difference = pmax(abs(RR - RR_prior), abs(conf_low - conf_low_prior), abs(conf_high - conf_high_prior)))
  check("All 68 stored-weight controls reproduce prior estimates and confidence intervals", nrow(validation) == 68L &&
    all(validation$max_abs_difference < 1e-7) && all(validation$n_rows == validation$n_rows_prior) &&
    all(validation$n_patients == validation$n_patients_prior), sprintf("maximum absolute difference %.3g", max(validation$max_abs_difference)))
  write_csv(validation, "stored_weight_control_validation.csv")
  corrected_prior <- utils::read.csv(file.path(table3_exploration$out_dir, "estimates_long.csv"))
  corrected_validation <- dplyr::filter(results, scheme == "v23_five_settings", status != "Structural zero") |>
    dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::filter(corrected_prior, weight != "unweighted", status != "Structural zero"),
      by = c("domain", "stratification", "origin", "direction", "weight"), suffix = c("", "_corrected"))
  check("All 68 corrected five-setting controls reproduce the corrected main exploration", nrow(corrected_validation) == 68L &&
    max(abs(corrected_validation$RR - corrected_validation$RR_corrected)) < 1e-7 &&
    max(abs(corrected_validation$conf_low - corrected_validation$conf_low_corrected)) < 1e-7 &&
    max(abs(corrected_validation$conf_high - corrected_validation$conf_high_corrected)) < 1e-7)
  write_csv(corrected_validation, "corrected_five_setting_control_validation.csv")
  joint <- dplyr::filter(results, stratification == "Index x first-readmission intensity")
  comparison <- joint |> dplyr::select(domain, origin, direction, lag, n_rows, n_patients, scheme, RR, conf_low, conf_high, robust_se, status) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = scheme, values_from = c(RR, conf_low, conf_high, robust_se, status)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RR_ratio_joint_vs_stored = RR_joint_15_strata / RR_stored,
      RR_ratio_joint_vs_v23_five = RR_joint_15_strata / RR_v23_five_settings,
      RR_ratio_v23_five_vs_stored = RR_v23_five_settings / RR_stored,
      se_ratio_joint_vs_stored = robust_se_joint_15_strata / robust_se_stored,
      CI_width_ratio_joint_vs_stored = (conf_high_joint_15_strata - conf_low_joint_15_strata) / (conf_high_stored - conf_low_stored),
      joint_CI_includes_one = conf_low_joint_15_strata <= 1 & conf_high_joint_15_strata >= 1,
      stored_CI_includes_one = conf_low_stored <= 1 & conf_high_stored >= 1)
  original <- results |> dplyr::filter(scheme == "v23_five_settings", domain == "All episodes", stratification == "Index setting") |>
    dplyr::select(origin, lag, original_RR = RR, original_low = conf_low, original_high = conf_high)
  comparison <- comparison |> dplyr::left_join(original, by = c("origin", "lag")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RR_ratio_joint_vs_original_Table3 = RR_joint_15_strata / original_RR)
  write_csv(comparison, "old_vs_reestimated_weights_comparison.csv")
  parent_control <- results |> dplyr::filter(stratification == "Index setting") |>
    dplyr::select(domain, origin, lag, scheme, RR, conf_low, conf_high) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = scheme, values_from = c(RR, conf_low, conf_high)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(max_abs_difference = pmax(abs(RR_v23_five_settings - RR_stored),
      abs(conf_low_v23_five_settings - conf_low_stored), abs(conf_high_v23_five_settings - conf_high_stored)))
  write_csv(parent_control, "v23_five_setting_control_vs_stored.csv")
  q_results <- list()
  for (domain in domains) for (lag in c("lag0", "lag1")) for (scheme in schemes) {
    jj <- joint[joint$domain == domain & joint$lag == lag & joint$scheme == scheme & joint$status != "Structural zero", ]
    stopifnot(nrow(jj) == 12L)
    add_q <- function(x, scope) {
      qq <- cochran_q(x, scope, domain, if (lag == "lag0") "w0_tr" else "w1_tr")
      qq$lag <- lag; qq$scheme <- scheme
      q_results[[length(q_results) + 1L]] <<- qq
      qq
    }
    total <- add_q(jj, "Across 12 joint strata")
    within <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(settings, function(origin)
      add_q(jj[jj$origin == origin, ], paste("Across intensity groups within", origin))))
    qq <- within[1L, ]; qq$scope <- "Combined intensity heterogeneity within index settings"
    qq$k <- 12L; qq$Q <- sum(within$Q); qq$df <- sum(within$df)
    qq$p_value <- stats::pchisq(qq$Q, qq$df, lower.tail = FALSE)
    qq$strata <- "Sum of five disjoint within-index-setting Q statistics; 7 degrees of freedom"
    stopifnot(qq$df == 7L, qq$Q <= total$Q + 1e-8)
    q_results[[length(q_results) + 1L]] <- qq
    for (direction in directions) add_q(jj[jj$direction == direction, ], paste("Across index settings within", tolower(direction)))
  }
  q_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(q_results)
  check("All 108 Q statistics equal contrast-Wald calculations", length(q_checks) == 108L && max(q_checks) < 1e-8,
    sprintf("maximum absolute difference %.3g", max(q_checks)))
  write_csv(q_results, "cochran_q_heterogeneity.csv")
  prior_q <- utils::read.csv(file.path(iiw15$previous_dir, "cochran_q_heterogeneity.csv"))
  q_control <- q_results |> dplyr::filter(scheme == "stored") |>
    dplyr::inner_join(prior_q, by = c("domain", "weight", "scope"), suffix = c("", "_prior"))
  check("All 40 stored-weight Q controls reproduce", nrow(q_control) == 40L && max(abs(q_control$Q - q_control$Q_prior)) < 1e-7)
  write_csv(q_control, "cochran_q_control_validation.csv")
  rr_text <- function(rr, lo, hi) ifelse(is.na(rr), "Not possible", sprintf("%.3f (%.3f, %.3f)", rr, lo, hi))
  layouts <- list()
  for (domain in domains) for (lag in c("lag0", "lag1")) {
    dd <- results |> dplyr::filter(.data$domain == .env$domain, .data$lag == .env$lag,
      scheme == "joint_15_strata", stratification == "Index x first-readmission intensity") |>
      dplyr::mutate(estimate = rr_text(RR, conf_low, conf_high), direction = factor(direction, levels = directions)) |>
      dplyr::select(origin, direction, estimate) |> tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = direction, values_from = estimate)
    table3 <- original[original$lag == lag, ]
    dd <- dplyr::left_join(data.frame(origin = settings), dd, by = "origin") |>
      dplyr::left_join(table3[c("origin", "original_RR", "original_low", "original_high")], by = "origin") |>
      dplyr::transmute(`Index setting` = origin, `Corrected Table 3` = rr_text(original_RR, original_low, original_high),
        Higher = .data[[directions[1L]]], Same = .data[[directions[2L]]], Lower = .data[[directions[3L]]])
    name <- paste0("table3_layout_", if (domain == "All episodes") "all_episodes_" else "readmissions_", lag, ".csv")
    layouts[[name]] <- dd; write_csv(dd, name)
    IRdisplay::display_html(as.character(knitr::kable(dd, format = "html", caption = paste(domain, lag,
      "- adjusted PSUD RR for treatment non-completion (95% CI), with IIW re-estimated in each supported joint stratum."))))
  }
  display_comparison <- comparison |> dplyr::mutate(
    `Historical misaligned` = rr_text(RR_stored, conf_low_stored, conf_high_stored),
    `Corrected five-setting control` = rr_text(RR_v23_five_settings, conf_low_v23_five_settings, conf_high_v23_five_settings),
    `Re-estimated by joint stratum` = rr_text(RR_joint_15_strata, conf_low_joint_15_strata, conf_high_joint_15_strata)) |>
    dplyr::select(domain, origin, direction, lag, n_patients, `Historical misaligned`, `Corrected five-setting control`, `Re-estimated by joint stratum`, se_ratio_joint_vs_stored)
  write_csv(display_comparison, "comparison_display.csv")
  for (domain in domains) IRdisplay::display_html(as.character(knitr::kable(
    dplyr::filter(display_comparison, .data$domain == .env$domain, lag == "lag1") |> dplyr::select(-domain, -lag),
    format = "html", digits = 3, caption = paste(domain, "- lag1 comparison and robust-SE ratio (joint / stored)."))))
  q_display <- q_results |> dplyr::select(domain, lag, scheme, scope, Q, df, p_value) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = scheme, values_from = c(Q, p_value)) |>
    dplyr::filter(scope %in% c("Across 12 joint strata", "Combined intensity heterogeneity within index settings",
      "Across index settings within higher intensity", "Across index settings within same intensity", "Across index settings within lower intensity"))
  write_csv(q_display, "cochran_q_comparison_display.csv")
  IRdisplay::display_html(as.character(knitr::kable(q_display, format = "html", digits = 4,
    caption = "Exploratory Cochran Q comparisons using unrounded log-RRs and patient-robust variances; intervals and tests condition on estimated weights.")))
  plots <- list()
  for (domain in domains) {
    pd <- joint |> dplyr::filter(.data$domain == .env$domain, scheme %in% c("v23_five_settings", "joint_15_strata"), status != "Structural zero") |>
      dplyr::mutate(origin = factor(origin, levels = settings),
        row = factor(paste(origin, direction, sep = " | "), levels = rev(iiw15$cohort$joint[!iiw15$cohort$structural_zero])),
        Method = factor(unname(scheme_labels[scheme]), levels = unname(scheme_labels[c("v23_five_settings", "joint_15_strata")])))
    pd$y <- as.numeric(pd$row) + ifelse(pd$scheme == "v23_five_settings", .12, -.12)
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(pd, ggplot2::aes(x = RR, y = y, colour = Method, shape = Method)) +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .35, colour = "#777777") +
      ggplot2::geom_segment(ggplot2::aes(x = conf_low, xend = conf_high, yend = y), linewidth = .55) +
      ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2) + ggplot2::facet_wrap(~lag, nrow = 1) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(levels(pd$row)), labels = levels(pd$row), expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = .5)) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_log10(breaks = c(.8, 1, 1.2, 1.4, 1.6, 1.8)) +
      ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c("#737373", "#176488")) +
      ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 16)) +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "Adjusted PSUD risk ratio for treatment non-completion (95% CI)", y = NULL,
        colour = NULL, shape = NULL, title = NULL, subtitle = NULL, caption = NULL) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 10) +
      ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(), panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#222222"), strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"))
    name <- if (domain == "All episodes") "comparison_all_episodes" else "comparison_readmissions_only"
    ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = 10, height = 7.2, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = 10, height = 7.2, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
    plots[[name]] <- p
  }
  saveRDS(list(results = results, comparisons = comparison, q_results = q_results, parent_control = parent_control,
    diagnostics = diagnostics, layouts = layouts), file.path(out_dir, "aggregate_results.rds"))
  cat("Output directory:", out_dir, "\n")
  list(out_dir = out_dir, comparisons = comparison, q_results = q_results, plots = plots, parent_control = parent_control)
})(iiw15)
cat(sprintf("[iiw15 outcome comparison] elapsed: %.2f min\n", as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), .t0, units = "mins"))))

Corrected five-setting versus corrected joint-stratum IIW

Both estimators now use the corrected identifier order, episode-key join, administrative-follow-up alignment, time-lag initialization and Cox clustering. The five-setting weights are imported from the verified postrev23 bundle; 24 intensity models are fitted for the 12 observed strata and two initialization variants. Three combinations remain structurally impossible.

All 184 supported outcome fits completed successfully, including the explicitly labelled historical controls. The 68 historical controls reproduce the earlier analysis and the 68 corrected five-setting controls reproduce the refreshed main exploration. Every observed episode enters each applicable corrected intensity model; none has an invalid start/stop interval. Cox models use robust variance and no patient-ID coefficient. No intensity-fit warnings were emitted. Administrative-censoring rows remain omitted because their baseline covariates are missing under the inherited specification.

After pooled 2.5th/97.5th percentile truncation, joint-stratum episode-weight ESS ranges from 70.6% to 94.5% across the two variants and supported strata. ESS measures weight concentration, not the number of independent patients. Small strata, notably WO-int/lower (190 patients), require attention to interval width as well as point estimates. Q remains descriptive and conditional on estimated weights.

The earlier statement that the five-setting control discrepancy was unresolved is superseded: the handoff traced it to positional assignment of returned weights and administrative follow-up after numeric identifiers were converted to character. Historical misaligned weights are retained only to show the correction’s numerical impact; the figures compare the two corrected grouping strategies.

Comparison table, weight diagnostics, intensity diagnostics, and Cochran Q. The exact executed chunks and PNG/PDF figures are exported in the same directory.

All episodes: corrected five-setting versus corrected joint-stratum IIW. Adjusted PSUD risk ratios for treatment non-completion with patient-robust 95% confidence intervals. Hollow grey points use the corrected postrev23 five-setting weights; filled blue points use weights re-estimated within the 12 supported joint strata. Both panels use the same 67,957 episodes and 27,445 patients. Titles and explanatory text remain outside the exported image.
